definitions.explanation: People who belong to the same generational cohort or are roughly the same age. Used to describe shared experiences, perspectives, or connections among people of similar age.

examples.japanese: {同世代|どうせだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I have many friends of the same generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同世代|どうせだい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Since she's the same generation as me, we get along well in conversation.

examples.japanese: {同世代|どうせだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}ろう→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I see athletes of the same generation doing well, it makes me want to try harder too.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧ (generation). Used as a noun modifier ({同世代|どうせだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) or predicatively. Common in discussions about generational identity and shared cultural experiences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同世代|どうせだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (people of the same generation)
- {同世代|どうせだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ (popular among the same generation)
- {同世代|どうせだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧ (peers of the same generation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同年代|どうねんだい}→同年代：22399_dounendai⟧: same age range — very similar, slightly more focused on specific age
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: same class year — people who joined an organization at the same time
